paite: Ariel, Ariel, David puanin kaihna mun! kuamah kum gawm inla; ankuangluinate hongtung nawn hen;
english: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

paite: Huai hun chiangin Ariel ka lungjing sak dinga, huchiin sunna leh kahna a om ding; huan amah kei adingin Ariel bang ahi ding.
english: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth or, Ariel .

paite: Huan, nangmah sual tumin na kimah kon giah khum dinga, nangmah sual dingin umsuakna insangte ka bawl ding.
english: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

paite: Huchiin, puksakin na om dinga, leinuaia kipanin thu na gen dinga, na aw lah leivui lakah awlawlin a gingkhe ding; na aw lah dawi aisansiam jawl aw bang lelin leinuaia kipanin a pawt ding hi, na pau lah leivui laka kipanin a hongpawt siausiau ding hi.
english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

paite: Himahleh nang hondou mipite jaw leivui nel mahmah bangin a om ding uh, mi kihtakhuai mipite leng buhsi mangthang sekte bangin a om ding uh; ahi, huai tuh mitphiatkal louin a hongom guih ding.
english: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

paite: Van gingte, jinlingte, ging thupi mahmahte, pingpeite huihpite, hul mang thei meiin amah lah sepaihte TOUPA gawtin a om ding hi.
english: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

paite: Huchiin Ariel dou nam tengteng mi pite, amah leh a insang sualmi tengteng leh amah hihlungjingte tengteng, ihmu mang bang lel ahi ding uh, jana kilakna bang lel.
english: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

paite: Mi gilkialin mang a neihin an a ne a, ahihhangin a khangloua a bah lailaiin tui a duh lailai bang ahi ding hi; Zion tang sual, nam tengteng mipiute, huchibang ahi ding uh.
english: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

paite: Ding kinken unla, lamdang sa un, kituam unla, mittawin om un; a kham ua, himahleh uain jiak ahi kei; a hoi hoi ua, himahleh ju jiak ahi kei.
english: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

paite: TOUPAN ihmut limna kha na tunguah a sung buaa, na mit uh, jawlneite, a mitsi saka, na lu uh, mutheite, a khuhta ngala.
english: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

paite: Huchiin kilakna himhim nou adingin laibu bilh khum bikbek bang a hita, huailah miten laisiammi kiangah, Hehpihtakin huai simin, chiin a pe sek ua, aman, ka sim theikei, bilh khum bikbek ahi, a chi seka;
english: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please”; and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed:”

paite: Huan, laibu tuh laisiam loumi kiangah, Hehpihtakin hiai simin, chiin a pia ua, huan aman, Lai ka siam kei a chi hi.
english: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please”; and he says, “I can’t read.”

paite: Huan, TOUPAN, Hiai miten a hongnaih ua, a kam un leh a muk un a honpahtawi ua, himahleh a lungtang uh keia kipanin a gamlaa, a honlauna uleh mihingte thupiak min a sinsak lel uh ahi;
english: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and with their lips to honor me, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;

paite: Hiai mite lakah thillamdang ka hih behlap ding, thillamdang, thillamdang mahmah; huchiin a mipilte uh pilna a mangta dinga, a mi teite uh teina selin a omta ding, a chi a.
english: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”

paite: A thutup uh TOUPA laka sel dinga thuktaka zongmit a tung uh agik hi! a thilhihte u lah jial nuaiah a oma, Kuan a honmu dia? kuan a honthei dia? a chi uh.
english: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”

paite: Thilte na lumlet vek sek uh! Belvelpa bellei bang lela sehin a om sin ahia. thil bawlin a bawlpa tungthu-ah. Amah honbawl ka hi sama, a chih? a hih keileh, thil suktuaha omin a sutuahpa tungthu ah. Theihna himhim a neikei, a chih?
english: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay; that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me”; or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding?”

paite: Sawtlou chik nungin ahi ka hia. Lebanon lah lei hoih tak muna suahsakin a om sina, lei hoih tak mun lah gammanga seha a om sin?
english: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

paite: Huai niin bengngongten laibu thute a bil un a zata ding ua, mittoten mial nuai leh mial lak akipanin a muta ding uh.
english: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

paite: Thunuailutten leng TOUPA ah a nopna uh a khangsakta ding ua, mihingte laka gentheite Israelte Mi siangthou ah a kipakta ding uh,
english: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Mi lauhuai lah bangmahlou-a bawlin a omtaa, misimmohhat lah a daita, thulimlouhna ngaklahte tengteng lah hihmanthatin a omta ngal ua;
english: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

paite: Huaiten lah mi thupoi thu-ah thilhihkhialin a bawl sek ua, kulh kongpi ah taihilhmi awkna dingin thang a kam sek ua, mi diktat lah bangmahlou tohin a nawlkhin nak uhi.
english: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

paite: Huaijiakin TOUPA, Abraham tan pen. Jakob inkote tungthu ah hichin a chi hi: Jakobte jaw tuin a zahlak ta kei ding ua, a mai uh a mual nawn sam kei ding.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

paite: A ta uh, ka khut suakte, a lak ua a muh un, ka min a siangthousak zota ding uh; ahi, Jakobte Mi Siangthou a siangthousak ding ua, Israelte Pathian lah a kihtata ding uh.Khaa vakmangten leng a hontheisiam ta ding ua mi phunhatten sinsak thu a sinta ding uh.
english: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

paite: Khaa vakmangten leng a hontheisiam ta ding ua mi phunhatten sinsak thu a sinta ding uh.
english: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
